II: Dominant positive QRS (R ~0.98 mV), upright P and T
aVR: Inverted P, negative QRS, inverted T — normal for aVR
aVL: Small positive QRS (R ~0.20 mV), flat T
V1: rS pattern — small r, deep S. Normal for right precordial
V2: rS pattern transitioning — increasing r wave
V3: Transitional zone — r ~0.62 mV with diminishing S
V4: R wave dominant (R ~1.08 mV), normal progression
V5: Tallest precordial R wave (~1.48 mV), minimal S
V6: Lateral lead R ~1.22 mV, minimal S, upright T
